proof_summary: Integration by parts gives a three-term recurrence for \(J_m=\int_0^1(t^2-t)^m e^t\,dt\), showing from the initial values that the odd-index error \(a-e b\) equals \(-J_{m+1}/(m+1)!\). Since \(|t^2-t|\le 1/4\) on \([0,1]\), these errors decay geometrically; the sequence recurrence transfers the bound to even indices, yielding an overall \(O(n2^{-n})\) ratio error because the positive denominators are at least \(1\).
